description: Block Bash and Monitor commands that would put a Proton Pass value in front of the agent (openv export, pass-cli item view, --no-masking, ...). Needs jq; without it, or if the guard can't run, commands naming openv or pass-cli are blocked

hooks.command: bash "{{SKILL_DIR}}/hooks/guard-secrets.sh" || { s=$?; [ "$s" = 2 ] && exit 2; i=$(cat); c=${i#*'"command":"'}; c=${c%%'","'*}; case $c in *openv*|*pass-cli*|*pass:*) echo "openv guard couldn't run (exit $s), so commands naming openv, pass-cli or pass: are blocked. Reinstall openv, or remove its hook from ~/.claude/settings.json" >&2; exit 2;; esac; }
